visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older woman with short dark hair stands in a brightly lit indoor living room wearing a light blue denim dress featuring a checkered blue and white collar. She looks down at the dress, touching the fabric near her waist and then adjusting the collar with both hands while smiling. In the background, a wooden door, a patterned glass window, and a child's crib filled with colorful plush toys and a red plastic horse are visible. (2) The scene shifts slightly as she walks around the room to display the denim dress from different angles. A digital overlay appears on the left showing a young female model wearing the same dress, providing a direct visual comparison. She gestures toward her own body and the floor while maintaining a cheerful facial expression. (3) She enters the frame through a wooden doorway wearing a second outfit: a brown wool-like suit consisting of a structured blazer and a matching calf-length skirt. She smiles broadly at the camera, spins around once to show the back of the jacket, and then looks down at her waist. A young man wearing glasses and a light-colored jacket is seated on a brown sofa in the background, looking toward her. (4) The woman is now seen in a light green, short-sleeved polo-style dress with a black band on the left sleeve. She walks back and forth in front of the sofa, looking at the man and laughing. Several text bubbles containing social media comments and an image of a model in the green dress appear as floating overlays on the screen. (5) She stands still in the green dress, looking slightly embarrassed yet amused, while looking at the people off-camera. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the sequence. She eventually gestures dismissively toward the clothes and continues to interact with the man on the sofa.
